title: Autoloop feature ledger
description: Machine-checkable definition of done. The agent flips `passes` only after reproducing `steps` as a real user and recording `evidence`. The agent may add entries but must not delete them.

priority.description: Lower = sooner. Encode dependency order here.

steps.description: Reproducible user actions + assertions that define done.

passes.description: True only with evidence; never self-graded.

attempts.description: Failed tries; at the limit, escalate not retry.

evidence.description: Test name / screenshot path / journey transcript.
